description.value: The ACT Arts Centre is the primary performing arts and exhibition venue serving Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows, operated by Arts On (formerly Maple Ridge Pitt-Meadows Arts Council). It hosts live performances, community events, art exhibitions, and youth arts programs throughout the year. The venue sits near the core of Maple Ridge and draws visitors from across the region for cultural programming.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 57m; rack at 74m; rack at 99m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from the OSM URL. The FAQ subpage explicitly confirms public washrooms on both floors of The ACT, including accessible stalls. No bike parking, water refill, cafe, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. A notable discrepancy exists: the OSM address (11944 Haney Place) differs from the website contact address (22420 Dewdney Trunk Rd., Suite 300), and the organization has rebranded from 'The ACT Arts Centre / Maple Ridge Pitt-Meadows Arts Council' to 'Arts On', though the venue is still referred to as 'The ACT' in the FAQs.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM shows 11944 Haney Place, V2X 6G2; website contact page shows 22420 Dewdney Trunk Rd., Suite 300, V2X 3J5 (also V2X 6G1 in footer). The Haney Place address may be the physical venue while Dewdney Trunk is the administrative office — needs confirmation.

Name/branding mismatch: OSM uses 'The ACT Arts Centre' but the organization now operates under the brand 'Arts On' (arts-on.org). The ACT is still referenced as the venue name in FAQs but the website domain theactmapleridge.org serves Arts On content.
OSM had no phone number; 604-456-2308 sourced from website contact page.

Website footer also lists a separate ticket-purchase phone number (604.476.2787) and a lost-and-found contact email (info@mract.org) distinct from the general contact (info@arts-on.org) — multiple contact endpoints may cause confusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The venue is active and has confirmed washrooms making it minimally qualifying, but the OSM address (11944 Haney Place) does not match the website contact address (22420 Dewdney Trunk Rd., Suite 300), and the organization has rebranded to 'Arts On' — the physical venue location and current branding should be verified before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The FAQs are written in context of 'The ACT' as a physical venue, suggesting it remains the performance/exhibition building even after the council rebranded to Arts On. Bike parking and cyclist amenities are entirely unaddressed on the website.

wow_evidence: Primary performing arts and exhibition venue for Maple Ridge/Pitt Meadows — regional arts reference.
blurb: Maple Ridge's main arts centre: theatre and gallery.
